Clear information about this website and your correspondence with R&D MECA.

About this website

This website presents R&D MECA’s mechanical engineering and industrial maintenance services in Morocco. MecMaroc is the previous name of this activity. For questions about the website, contact contact@rdmeca.com or +33 7 45 76 80 10.

Preparing your enquiry

The contact form prepares an email in your email app. The form does not send your entries to a server. You review and send the enquiry yourself. Entries remain on the page while you use it and are not saved in browser storage.

Your correspondence with R&D MECA

When you send an email or message, your contact details and the information you share are used to understand your needs and respond. To request access, correction or deletion of your information, contact contact@rdmeca.com. Avoid sharing sensitive information before agreeing suitable communication arrangements.

Cookies and external services

This site’s content uses no advertising cookies or audience analytics. Images and fonts are hosted with the website. The hosting platform may process technical data needed to operate the site. WhatsApp links open a third-party service with its own privacy terms. Access to this preview may also use the hosting platform’s authentication.

Content and credits

The R&D MECA logo is supplied by the site owner. Photographs are industrial illustrations and do not depict R&D MECA facilities or projects. Photography: aluminum Zheng ji and Jelifer Maniago, via Unsplash. General website content does not replace the technical scoping of an assignment.
